requirements: 薪酬首、排班次、绩效第三，人事基础支撑

source_reading_scope: Menu/role/shared-capability sections of V7–V15 targeted read; full original specs remain authority. V7 advanced-leave appendix explicitly lacks full detailed algorithms. No claim of all vendor documents or code/UI read in this task.

AUTH_COMPLETE_GRANT.rule: One complete grant must cover function/action + group/company/store/contract/person/effective-history scope + field/state limits; explicit deny and group isolation prevail. Do not splice unrelated role scopes.
role_boundaries: group_hr business across authorized group and history, still follows enabled workflow/segregation
admin configuration, no automatic salary/plain data
demo all only isolated fictitious workspace
employee self and actual relations, not others
AUTH_COMPLETE_GRANT.execution_recheck: current permissions + frozen business/source revision + actual relationship/period + domain invariants at commit; menu visibility does not enforce authorization

SAVED_VIEW.personal_or_shared: Shared view has owner/audience/version; view recipient still intersects current source row/field/action permissions. Sharing does not share cached data or grant permission.
SAVED_VIEW.on_permission_loss: Hide unauthorized filter/column/candidate/count; invalidate protected cache/old downloads, do not silently widen query.
SAVED_VIEW.all_pages_selection: Default current page; cross-query selection freezes query/scope/version and asks explicit range acknowledgment; export not silently current page only

TASK_DRAFT.rule: Per actor + actual relation/task/revision saved draft; explicit saved/failed/conflict state; form draft is not submitted, exam draft is not sealed.

LIST_20.details: Tabs or independent sections; nested rows paginate independently. Large grids scroll inside grid.
LIST_20.pagination: Stable sort with unique tie-break key; server query/version token; refresh explains changing results, no cross-page duplicate business action.

CARDS_12.rule: Cards/list/diagram share same authorized query; choose intended interval before showing allocatable beds; observe-time vacancy not promise of future availability.

CANVAS.rule: Branch/viewport virtualization and bounded chunks, readable default scale; internal horizontal scrolling; data/time/source consistent across tree/network/list or day/week/month.
CANVAS.mobile: Explicit draw/edit mode, long press and start/end input alternatives; no Ctrl-only critical action.

DETAIL_SECTIONS.rule: Sticky person/organization identity + actual relation/as-of + breadcrumb; one active section, paginated child lists, no universal long page copying all modules.

FORM_STEPS.rule: Shared PC/mobile schema; source/entered/derived/reviewer fields separate; save/resume, error anchoring and impact/route preview; submit freezes exact revision.

DESIGNER.rule: PC main authoring; mobile read/preview/task handling where practical; draft/validate/simulate/publish versions; opening designer never changes running instances.

EXAM_STATE.rule: Candidate assigned attempt only vs author/marker duties separate; visible remaining deadline/answer revision/last confirmed save; manual submit confirms last saved answer revision; no navigation change resets quota.

REPORT_DESIGNER.rule: Approved semantic datasets only, typed joins/metrics and units; source dataset + field rights required for author and viewer; no unrestricted SQL or cross-domain data exfiltration via aggregate.

PORTAL.rule: Cards and task list project existing business identities and source states; no independent duplicated domain write; role workspace switch does not combine grants.

forbidden_equivalences: same person is not same employment or one wage

preset_families: 假期发放预占使用到期余额
绩效进度成绩奖金入薪
学习场次考试资格应用
宿舍房态人夜账单收付
用工服务量对账发票资金
集成覆盖失败与权限审计
report_design.authorization: Report ACL only narrows visibility; underlying row+field+derived policy always applies at query, count, totals, chart, drill, export generation and download. Saved report grants no new raw access.
report_design.aggregation: No mixing headcount with relation/task count; distinct person IDs where intended. No duplicate lower hierarchy totals, temporal joins, source adopts or all-in cost components. Incomparable currency/score/unit versions separated.
report_design.custom_builder: P0 select permitted dataset/fields, filters, authorized grouping, approved metrics, preview and share/publish. P1 advanced validated cross-dataset joins or formulas; not free SQL. Missing required customer metric is a tracked dependency, not invented value.
report_design.download: Freeze query/source/definition/version and authorized scope; generate and download both reauthorize, signed expiring reference, field policy/watermark/audit. Revoke invalid actor/expired grants; errors contain no unauthorized matching candidates.
report_design.scheduled_generation: Named bounded execution identity and current authorization at trigger/execution, then query/export generation/download reauthorization; revoked owner/scope stops or reapproval, source/definition revision frozen; schedule creates no permanent audience grant.

portal_design.PC: 7 business groups by priority; top current workspace/company/relation/search/tasks, bottom system/integration independently. Only authorized groups shown; demo shows all in fake workspace.
portal_design.mobile: 3–5 persistent entries selected per role: 工作台、办事、待办、我的; attendance staff/store manager may pin排班, salary staff may pin工资任务. Same canonical page/object/action schema with role projection, not separate permissions.
portal_design.external_tasks: Candidate Offer/signature/supplier specific tasks use verified task-scoped external identity as V10; not public roster or knowledge-of-phone access. No new public HR portal invented.
